text:
micah: FYI ran into a weird one while helping a new user onboard their sampleapp. bundle + edge runtime + auth retries = crash on first request

jade: ugh, details? reproducible? which bundler (vite/webpack/rollup)? node/edge?

micah: Vite (latest), target=esnext, ESM package. Repro steps below. Happens only when we build the sampleapp for edge (Cloudflare/Vercel). Local dev `vite dev` works fine.

micah: Repro steps:
```bash
git clone git@github.com:redwood/sampleapp-sdk-bundler-repro.git
cd sampleapp-sdk-bundler-repro
# checkout the branch I used
git checkout micah/bundler-edge-auth-repro
npm ci
# build for edge
npm run build:edge
# deploy locally with wrangler or run a static preview that uses edge runtime shim
wrangler pages dev dist --port 8787
```

micah: Then hit `/api/generate` which calls our SDK (imported as `import Redwood from 'redwood'`) — first request 500s with: `ReferenceError: Headers is not defined` (stack points to SDK auth retry path).

jade: Headers not defined sounds like runtime global missing — edge should have Headers though? stacktrace plz.

micah: stack snippet:```
TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'get')
 at maybeAttachAuth (node_modules/redwood/dist/index.mjs:234:12)
 at RedClient.generate (node_modules/redwood/dist/index.mjs:412:9)
```

micah: When I inspect the bundle (`node_modules/redwood/dist/index.mjs` in the built output) there's an IIFE that tries to detect global `fetch`/`Headers` and falls back to `globalThis.fetch` but during tree-shake/rollup optimizing the polyfill helper got removed because it was behind `if (typeof globalThis.Request === 'undefined')` (dead code elimination).

oliver: 😬 that sounds like bundler optimization + conditional polyfill got pruned. maybe `sideEffects` or `exports` fields break import path retention. Which package entrypoints are you using (module vs main)?

micah: package.json for sampleapp imports "redwood": "^1.2.0" and Vite resolves `module` field (index.mjs). The SDK publishes both cjs and esm, but our ESM buildup relies on a small runtime guard to attach global fetch. In some bundler configs the guard is statically false and the helper removed.

jade: Could this also be related to the auth retry: we call `client.generate()` with `retry: { retries: 2 }` and the retry code wraps `fetch` — if helper is gone it tries to call undefined and crashes. Any repro where you set `retry: 0`?

micah: yeah with `retry: 0` it doesn't crash (skips retry path). So root cause is the retry code path referencing the helper that got tree-shaken under certain optimizer scenarios.

micah: Minimal patch I used locally: export a tiny `attachGlobals()` named export from the SDK entry that we call from the app bootstrap before any request: `import { attachGlobals } from 'redwood'; attachGlobals();` That forces it to stay in bundle. But that's a bad DX for onboarding.

jade: We should document a workaround in quickstart and fix on SDK side. Possible fixes: 1) make the helper a top-level import (avoid conditional that can be resolved false at build-time), 2) ship a tiny file path that platforms import implicitly (e.g., `redwood/edge-shims`) or 3) ensure package `exports` points to an entry that always contains the guard.

oliver: Also need TypeScript typings note: TS users saw `Property 'retry' does not exist on type GenerateRequest` in sample app because the `types` entry points to CJS d.ts which misses the extended options. Could be separate publishing step bug.

micah: repro for typing error: fresh TS template, `import Redwood from 'redwood'` then `client.generate({ prompt: 'x', retry: { retries: 1 } })` => tsc error. Quick fix: `// @ts-ignore` or import the `types` via `import type { GenerateOptions } from 'redwood/dist/types';` but that's terrible.

jade: OK action items: 1) devex doc with repro steps + minimal fix snippet (micah) 2) SDK team to ensure retry path retains the helper (oliver) 3) publish types fix for ESM entry (oliver) 4) add a line in onboarding quickstart about Vite optimizeDeps or calling `attachGlobals()` as temporary shim (micah) 5) add a CI test that builds sampleapp with Vite, rollup and webpack for edge and runs basic smoke request (sam-ci-bot)

sam-ci-bot: reminder: I added a flaky test ticket RED-3124 to the pipeline board (https://internal/board/RED-3124) :robot_face:

micah: Proposed quickstart blurb to add:```
If you deploy to an edge runtime and use Vite/Rollup, you may see a runtime error caused by bundler dead-code elimination of auth helpers. Workarounds:
1) In your app entry, call `import { attachGlobals } from 'redwood'; attachGlobals();` before any SDK calls.
2) For Vite, add to `vite.config.js`:
optimizeDeps: { include: ['redwood'] }
3) Pin `retry: 0` temporarily if you must avoid the retry path.
```

jade: good. can you also paste the small failing bundle snippet so SDK folks can see why it got pruned?

micah: pasted diff in thread gist: https://gist.github.com/micah/sha1-repro — gist shows `if (typeof Request === 'undefined') { /* attach */ } else { /* no-op */ }` where the bundler resolved `typeof Request !== 'undefined'` at build time and removed branch with attach.

oliver: thanks — I'll move this to SDK backlog, label `edge-bundler-interop` and `types` and attempt a fix that exports the guard from a stable entrypoint. Also will add a smoke build to SDK release CI.

dev-onboard: Adding a short note to quickstart and including the `vite.config` tip. I'll draft a one-liner onboarding FAQ: "Edge builds may require optimizeDeps include or calling attachGlobals to avoid missing runtime globals in some bundlers."

micah: thanks everyone. filing the minimal reproduction as a repo under `internal/sampleapps` and linking it to RED-3124. Will follow up with a PR for the quickstart tonight. :rocket:
